rv.q: Despite the minor drawbacks, the show is an experimental triumph.

What is the recipe for a Fringe play? Not necessarily a successful one, but any Fringe production, whether in Edinburgh, London or elsewhere. First, you need the means: a company, complete with cast, crew, technical team and a collective vision to get a show on the road. Then you need time.
I A Mixtape is innovative, daring, and compelling.
This is a show that invites you to the party as a guest, not simply an audience member.

cn.t: This nostalgic 90s celebration divides critics with its energetic alt-rock soundtrack and movement-driven storytelling earning praise, though some question whether the genre-defying format fully delivers on its ambitious premise.
